summary: The peer was sacked from his position in 2025 after his close links with Jeffrey Epstein emerged The Liberal Democrats are saying the UK needs a proper plan for immigration. This is from the party’s asylum and immigration spokesperson, Paul Kohler . Britain needs to regain control of its immigration system after the chaos of Brexit. Yet sixteen years after David Cameron’s ‘tens of thousands’ pledge, six prime ministers and ten home secretaries have overseen wild swings in immigration numbers with net migration now set to fall below zero. Britain faces serious demographic and economic challenges, and urgently needs a proper immigration plan to support our economy and public services. The fall in net migration is mainly a result of changes made by the previous Conservative government. We now need to go even further with a legally binding annual cap, set by parliament, at a far lower level. British and European people are leaving in their droves because of Labour’s high taxes whilst non-EU immigration remains far too high.
